metadata.technology_reasoning: NGS platforms have become the dominant form of DNA sequencing technology since early 2010s due to their massively parallel sequencing capability, high throughput, and reduced cost compared to older Sanger methods. Leading commercial models such as Illumina, Thermo Fisher Ion Torrent, and BGI use sequencing-by-synthesis or semiconductor sequencing techniques, establishing them as industry-standard forms of DNA sequencers in 2024.
